utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — we still need a few volunteers, a couple of tool donations, and someone to help sort the sign-up list. I’ll send around the details, and we can divide it up from there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I can help sort the sign-up list. Send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli — what kind of help can you give, and when can you do it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can spare some tools and a few hours on Saturday morning. I’d rather keep my name out of it for now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but we should check the timing and who’s bringing what first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Good point — I’ll check the timing and then we can sort out who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. Let me know the timing, and I’ll keep an eye on the list so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s happening. I’ll send the details soon so you’ve got everything straight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — I’ll wait for your message. Just want to make sure I don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I might’ve missed the latest details—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking the latest location now, then I’ll let you know where the repair drive is set up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal. I’ll wait for the location—just let me know when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m happy to help, though I may need a reminder on the details. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — I’m still sorting the details, but I’ll send you the list and where to drop things off. I just want to make sure we keep it simple and don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, that sounds good — send it over when you can, and I’ll do my best to keep up. I’m sure I can handle simple and tidy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to bring my tools by the repair drive and see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s really kind of you — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I think they’ll be glad for the extra help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by early and check what needs fixing first. If they already have a list, I’ll follow that and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like a good turn for the neighborhood—what do you need me to spread the word about?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Just let folks know we’re organizing the repair drive and could use hands, tools, and any spare supplies they’re willing to lend.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll pass that along while I’m out—hands, tools, and spare supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m a bit late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. We just need to sort the donations and load the last boxes, then we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll sort the donations and help load the last boxes right now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a spare drill and a box of screwdrivers if the repair drive needs them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds useful—what condition are they in, and do you know if the drill battery is charged?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: They’re in good shape, and I’ll check the drill battery before I bring them over. If it’s low, I can top it up tonight.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in—just let me know the plan and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send over the schedule and where we need help, and we’ll keep it simple around school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — send me the schedule when you can, and I’ll plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together a repair drive this weekend—come by if you’d like to help or just say hi. I’ll send the details around to everyone nearby!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’d like to stop by and help if I can. Send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details as soon as I have them, and I’d love to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How far along are we on the repair drive, Oren?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — we’ve made a little progress, but I should check the tally before I say too much. I’ll get you the latest numbers soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—can you send me the latest tally when you’ve checked?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Tess — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you, Sam! Could you help spread the word and maybe come by this Saturday to sort donations and tools?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can spread the word and I’ll come by this Saturday to help sort the donations and tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in. Let me know what you need, Kira.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Jules—can you confirm you’ll handle the word-of-mouth part, and let me know who you connect with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll handle the word-of-mouth part and keep you posted on who I connect with. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve talked to folks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the repair drive stops—just tell me the first location and I’ll note the rest.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—let’s start at Maple Street, then we can work our way down the block.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—Maple Street is first. I’ll keep the list moving as we go.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Noah—I'm happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Mara—sorry, I was a little distracted. Could you help spread the word and maybe keep an eye on donations?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I can spread the word and keep an eye on the donations. Just let me know where to share the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Sam — I can help organize the repair drive and keep everything moving smoothly. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — let’s start by listing the biggest repair needs and then we can match them with volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great idea, Sam — I’ll start a list of the biggest repair needs and we can pair each one with the right volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive—what do we still need?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what’s already covered? I can grab whatever’s still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’ve got some basic tools and a few boxes of screws covered, but we’re still short on paint, gloves, and a couple of work lights.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the basics and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — we’re short on duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and a few spare screws. If you can bring those, that’d cover the basics.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can grab those and bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s starting up soon—people are already asking what needs fixing. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that—there are a few things I’m hoping to sort out, but I’m keeping it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep it quiet and let you know if I hear anything helpful.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—what still needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We still need volunteers for the biggest repairs, plus donations of tools and materials. If you can help, I’ll point you to the most urgent spots.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what are the most urgent spots right now?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I have the details right before I help—what time is the repair drive, and what still needs to be done?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure on the time yet, but I can check while I’m out. As for what’s left, I think we still need a few more volunteers and some supplies sorted.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that helps. Please check the time when you can, and let me know which supplies are still needed so I can help sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—just let me know what time window you’re aiming for.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Faye — that’d help a lot. I’m thinking Saturday morning would be best, if that works around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should work—I’ll check the school schedule and let you know if anything conflicts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m glad folks are pitching in. If you know what still needs doing, I’d love an update.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m a little fuzzy on the full list, but I know they still need volunteers and a few more supplies. I can check and let you know later.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’d appreciate that. I’m happy to help once I know what’s needed.
